$comment: Our own multiplayer strings (PLAN LOC-02), merged into the en-us MP localization by scripts/balatro/build-game-pack.py. Same shape as a game localization table. English is authoritative; a translation goes in extra-strings.<lang>.json with the same keys (a key missing there falls back to English). Keys start with rmh_mp_ and must not collide with the mod's keys (the builder fails if they do). Keep the text to characters the game fonts draw: the builder checks every shipped string against the glyph bitmap.

dictionary.rmh_mp_runner_hunters_gain_life: Runner: every Hunter gains a life
dictionary.rmh_mp_kicked: You were removed from the lobby
